mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(SUMMARY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "summaryDate", USAGE_COUNT AS "usageCount", RESERVATION_COUNT AS "reservationCount", VISITOR_COUNT AS "visitorCount" FROM DAILY_PARKING_SUMMARY WHERE SUMMARY_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND SUMMARY_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY SUMMARY_DATE

WITH recent_events AS ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PARKING_USAGE_ID, VEHICLE_NUMBER, PARKING_SPACE_ID, ENTRY_AT AS EVENT_AT, 'ENTRY' AS EVENT_TYPE FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE ENTRY_AT IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT PARKING_USAGE_ID, VEHICLE_NUMBER, PARKING_SPACE_ID, EXIT_AT AS EVENT_AT, 'EXIT' AS EVENT_TYPE FROM PARKING_USAGE WHERE EXIT_AT IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY EVENT_AT DESC, PARKING_USAGE_ID DESC, EVENT_TYPE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5 ) SELECT e.PARKING_USAGE_ID AS "parkingUsageId", e.VEHICLE_NUMBER AS "vehicleNumber", e.EVENT_TYPE AS "eventType", TO_CHAR(e.EVENT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "occurredAt", CASE WHEN f.FLOOR_NO IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(f.FLOOR_NO) || 'F-' || z.ZONE_CODE || s.SPACE_NUMBER END AS "spaceCode" FROM recent_events e LEFT JOIN PARKING_SPACE s ON s.PARKING_SPACE_ID = e.PARKING_SPACE_ID LEFT JOIN PARKING_ZONE z ON z.PARKING_ZONE_ID = s.PARKING_ZONE_ID LEFT JOIN PARKING_FLOOR f ON f.PARKING_FLOOR_ID = z.PARKING_FLOOR_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_AT DESC, e.PARKING_USAGE_ID DESC, e.EVENT_TYPE DESC
